masterStill.title: 1. Master Still (Chế độ hibit 8×8 Majority-Vote)
masterStill.prompt: [HIBIT MASTER STILL SPEC] Character: Hiệp Sĩ Thánh Quang (Thánh Kỵ Sĩ Giáp Bạc), rarity=SSR, element=solar. Render flat unoutlined cel-shaded regions with strictly <= 3 discrete shades per material for 8x8 majority-vote downscaling to a 64x64 logical canvas. Top-left directional lighting. Lock both feet on horizontal baseline Y=88 (pivot=32,56). Solid chroma key background (#00FF00) with zero color spill. Leave >=8px silhouette padding around extremities.
constraints: Max shades per material: 3 | Max palette: 16 colors
Chroma Key BEFORE Quantize | Binary Alpha {0, 255}

characterBible.title: 2. Character Bible 23 Khung & 8 Hướng Đối Xứng
characterBible.prompt: [CHARACTER BIBLE 23-PANEL SPEC] Subject: Hiệp Sĩ Thánh Quang. Generate a synchronized 23-panel design sheet: 5 orthographic turnaround views (S, SW, W, NW, N; derive SE, E, NE via deterministic horizontal mirror flip to save 37.5% generation cost), 6 dialogue expressions (neutral, determined, victory, hurt, arcane-trance, command), 3 combat action keyposes, 3 ascension skins (vanguard-armor, astral-robe, crimson-awakened), 1 chibi form, and a '-damaged' variant whose bounding box deviates by <=1px from the base pose.
constraints: 5 hướng sinh gốc (S, SW, W, NW, N) + 3 hướng lật gương (SE, E, NE) → tiết kiệm 37,5% chi phí
6 biểu cảm hội thoại + 3 Skin tiến hóa + 1 Chibi + biến thể -damaged lệch khung bao <= 1px

paperdoll.title: 3. Paper-Doll 7 Lớp & Khung Vũ Khí Quá Khổ 96×96
paperdoll.prompt: [CONCENTRIC PAPERDOLL 7-LAYER SPEC] Decompose Hiệp Sĩ Thánh Quang into 7 bit-exact RGBA layers sharing a concentric ground pivot: body layers (00_shadow, 10_body greyscale-tintable, 20_iris green-key isolated, 30_outfit, 40_hair) on 64x64 canvas (pivot=(32, 56)), and oversized equipment layers (50_weapon, 60_fx) on 96x96 canvas (pivot=(48, 72)) so broadswords and polearms never clip during swing arcs.
constraints: Tách riêng tròng mắt (Iris Key) và lớp cơ sở trắng xám để đổi màu runtime không lem

motion.title: 4. Hoạt Ảnh, Khử Bò Viền (Crawl Killer) & Khóa Bàn Chân
motion.prompt: [I2V & REGION-MASK MOTION SPEC] Generate 5 game-ready clips (idle, walk, attack, hurt, victory). For 'idle', apply anatomical breathing and cape oscillation strictly inside region masks while preserving resting torso pixels 100% byte-identical. For 'walk' and 'attack', run CIELAB chroma key BEFORE palette quantization, enforce Temporal Hysteresis (Crawl Killer: commit_frames=2, max_hold=3 starvation escape), and lock contact foot to Y=88 with Alpha-Weighted Centroid stabilization.
constraints: Temporal Hysteresis: commit_frames = 2, max_hold = 3 (chống nhấp nháy viền)
Region-Masked Idle: giữ nguyên 100% byte vùng thân đứng yên
Dual-Buffer VFX: kênh color + kênh emissive_light tách biệt kèm metadata act

world.title: 5. Bản Đồ 16-Tile Wang Autotile, Parallax & 2.5D Normals
world.prompt: [WANG 16-AUTOTILE & PARALLAX SPEC] Biome: Thánh Điện Hắc Diện (16-Tile Wang Autotile) (obsidian-Sanctum). Construct a 16-tile Wang/Blob autotile set (16x16px per tile) with crisp stepped stone/rune transitions, paired with a 3-layer parallax battle stage (sky_far, ruins_mid, arena_ground) using a disciplined 14-color palette and 2.5D normal/specular/emissive maps.
constraints: 16 biến thể bitmask (0..15) ghép liền mạch không vết nối
3 lớp Parallax Battle Stage + bộ 3 bản đồ ánh sáng (_normal, _specular, _emissive)
